title: PXAPI problem v1
description: A transport-neutral, client-readable description of why an operation did not succeed. It carries no HTTP status, no type URI and no transport binding; a later adapter maps it onto its transport. Every text member is single-line, bounded and built from fixed templates so that tracebacks, filesystem paths, secrets and raw internal exception messages cannot appear.

code.description: Required. A stable machine-readable problem code. The codes known at this version are listed in the manifest; the set is open, and a client must handle a code it does not know as a generic problem.

title.description: Required. A short, single-line, human-readable summary that is the same for every occurrence of the code.

detail.description: Required. A single-line, bounded explanation specific to this occurrence, rendered from a fixed template. Never validator free text, never a traceback, never a path.

run_id.description: Optional. The Analysis Run the problem is attributable to. Absent means the problem is not attributable to a run (e.g. the request never became one).

pointer.description: Required. An RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the offending document; the empty string is the document root.

keyword.description: Required. The JSON Schema keyword that was violated (e.g. required, const, pattern, additionalProperties).

message.description: Required. A single-line, templated statement of the violation.

errors.description: Required. The individual violations for a validation problem; empty for problems that are not about a document.
